DIAGNOSIS READY: Trigeminal Neuralgia (likely secondary to surgical trauma or compression) causing referred otalgia and auricular discomfort.

The shooting pain triggered by eating and the distribution you described are classic for Trigeminal Neuralgia affecting the mandibular branch, which can also cause pain when touching the ear (earring discomfort). The imaging will confirm if there is a vascular loop compressing the nerve or a nerve sheath issue post-surgery. Do you notice any facial weakness or numbness on the right side?
